name: Ivar's Head
summary: In northern Silverpine, Ivar's Head proves Ivar the Foul is dead. Rane Yorick seeks it so her wounded brother Quinn can recover safely.

sections.title: A Severed Threat
sections.body: Rane and Quinn Yorick were scouting northern Silverpine Forest on High Executor Hadrec's orders when Ivar the Foul ambushed them at an abandoned farmstead. The Forsaken Deathstalkers drove the feral ghoul off, but Quinn was badly mauled. Rane stayed at the ruined farm to watch over him and could not safely leave to finish their mission. Ivar's severed head proves the ghoul will no longer threaten the estate, giving Quinn time to recover under Rane's care.

faq.answer: The head belonged to Ivar the Foul, a savage ghoul haunting the abandoned farmstead called the Ivar Patch in northern Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: Why does Rane Yorick want Ivar's head?
faq.answer: Rane wants proof that Ivar is dead. The ghoul badly mauled her brother Quinn, who needs time to recover without fear of another ambush before they report back to High Executor Hadrec.

faq.q: Where was Ivar the Foul found?
faq.answer: Ivar the Foul lurks inside the dilapidated barn at the Ivar Patch, waiting for the wounded Deathstalkers to let their guard down.

angles.text: As a Forsaken scout, you know wild ghouls are mindless liabilities. They disrupt military reconnaissance and threaten Lordaeron's young security.
As a member of the Horde, you know removing Scourge remnants like Ivar protects Horde couriers traveling through northern Silverpine toward the Sepulcher.
